{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to numeric
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining NaN values
print("Number of NaN values in 'revenue' after cleaning:", data['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Verify the premises
print("\nCustomer segments:", data['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Status values:", data['status'].unique())

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
data_loyal_completed = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if there are any such orders
print("\nNumber of LOYAL completed orders:", len(data_loyal_completed))

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = data_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print("\nMean revenue of LOYAL completed orders:", mean_revenue)

# Display the first few rows of the filtered data
data_loyal_completed.head()"}
